next.reason: 1985: "CLOSE {file-name-1 ║[WITH LOCK]║} …"; 2023: "CLOSE {file-name-1 [{REEL|UNIT} [FOR REMOVAL] | WITH NO REWIND]} … — no WITH LOCK phrase". The 2023 CLOSE format still accepts CLOSE file-name-1 … for indexed files but drops the WITH LOCK phrase. REEL, UNIT and NO REWIND are for sequential files only.
